caseName: Nevada Department of Human Resources v. Hibbs
caseNameFull: Nevada Department of Human Resources Et Al. v. Hibbs Et Al.

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 536 U. S. 938.] Motion of the Solicitor General for divided argument granted. Motion of petitioners Nevada Department of Human Resources et al. and State of Alabama for leave for State of Alabama to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument denied.
